--C.help: Specify a combo wordlist deiminated by ':', example: user1:password

--H.help: Target in the format service://host:port, CIDR ranges supported,\n default port will be used if not specified

--P.help: Print found hosts parsed from provided host and file arguments

--T.help: Number of hosts to bruteforce at the same time

--allow-wrapper.help: Allow the wrapper module to execute arbitrary commands (required for security)

--badkeys-only.help: Run SSH bad-keys pre-pass only; skip password attempts

--checkpoint.help: Checkpoint file path for resume capability

--config.help: YAML config file (CLI flags override config values)

--d.help: Domain to use for RDP authentication (optional)

--debug.help: debug error output from medusa [0-10], default=5

--debug-audit.help: Write redacted per-attempt diagnostics to JSONL

--delay.help: Per-host delay between attempts (e.g. 10s); alias for -rate, mutually exclusive

--e.help: Extra password checks: n=blank password, s=password=username, r=reversed username, combine: nsr

--f.help: File to parse; Supported: Nmap, Nessus, Nexpose, Lists, etc

--file.help: GNMAP, JSON or XML file to parse

--hosts.help: number of hosts to test concurrently

--iface.help: Specific network interface to use for bruteforce traffic (defaults to active interface)

--insecure.help: Deprecated: TLS certificate verification is always disabled for bruteforce

--log-every.help: Print every N attempts when not in silent mode (>=1)

--max-conn-fails.help: Consecutive connection failures before skip policy trips (0 = policy default)

--module-help.help: Print module defaults and accepted module params for a service or all

--modules.help: dump a list of available modules to brute

--no-badkeys.help: Skip SSH bad-keys pre-pass for SSH targets

--no-rdp-scan.help: Skip pre-auth RDP recon (NLA fingerprint, sticky-keys probe)

--no-stats.help: Disable statistics tracking for better performance

--no-tui.help: Disable interactive terminal UI, use legacy output mode

--output-format.help: Output format: text (default) or json (JSONL per-attempt)

--p.help: Password or password file to use for bruteforce

--proxy-list.help: File containing proxy list (one socks5://host:port per line) for rotation

--r.help: Amount of times to retry after receiving connection failed

--rate.help: Per-host rate limit in attempts/second; fractional values supported (e.g. 0.1 = 1 attempt every 10s; 0 = unlimited)

--resume.help: Resume from a checkpoint file (saved automatically on interrupt)

--route-diagnostics.help: Print selected local route/source address per target

--s.help: Service type: ssh, ftp, smtp, etc; Default all

--schedule.help: Credential queue schedule: auto, host-major, spray, pairwise (deterministic execution also needs -t 1 -T 1)

--silent.help: Suppress per-attempt console logs (still records successes and summary)

--skip-policy.help: Connection-failure skip policy: auto, off, conservative, aggressive

--socks5.help: Socks5 proxy to use for bruteforce (supports socks5://user:pass@host:port or host:port)

--spray.help: Spray mode: try each password across all users before next password (avoids lockouts)

--spray-delay.help: Delay between password rounds in spray mode

--stop-on-success.help: Stop testing a host after finding valid credentials

--summary.help: Generate comprehensive summary report with statistics

--t.help: Number of threads per host (also acts as max threads per host)

--u.help: Username or user list to bruteforce For SMBNT and RDP, use domain\username format (e.g., CORP\jdoe)

--w.help: Set timeout delay of bruteforce attempts
